reason: The text features multiple regular human characters exercising agency and decision-making: Pharaoh makes the critical decision to release the Israelites (וַיִּקְרָא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן... וַיֹּאמֶר קוּמוּ צְּאוּ); the Israelites act independently (וַיִּשָּׂא הָעָם אֶת־ בְּצֵקוֹ, they take their dough; וַֽיִּשְׁאֲלוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם, they ask items from Egyptians); and the Egyptians respond with their own will (וַתֶּחֱזַק מִצְרַיִם עַל־ הָעָם לְמַהֵר לְשַׁלְּחָם, the Egyptians urged the people to hurry and let them go, motivated by their own survival fears). These are not passive recipients but agents making choices, even within the larger framework of divine intervention.
